notes: Cervical-dystonia trial data drawn from the repo's own Class-Material/Data/cdystonia.csv, read inline as DATALINES so the bundle is self-contained. PROC CONTENTS, then a DATA step building new_id = site*100+id, PROC SORT + PROC MEANS BY treat*week (mean TWSTRS), and PROC FREQ treat*sex with a chi-square test. Substitutions vs the original: PROC IMPORT replaced by an inline DATA step on the same data, and the FREQ chi-square run over the full table (the original ran BY week, producing sparse single-cell tables). obs=100 caps the rows.
